findings: B9-COLOR: The validator correctly admits the pinned 157 names/symbols and 1/3/6/8-digit hex grammar, but the resolved return carries an untyped color string into a renderer handling only 3/6-digit hex and a subset of named colors. Java returns HColorNone for transparent and an XColor with alpha for eight digits; Rust emits white for transparent, literal #a instead of #AAAAAA, and an unexpanded RGBA fill without Java's fill-opacity. External return destinations and geometry match in the isolated RGBA controls; these are shared color-model failures, not evidence that command ownership is wrong. Next repair: Preserve normalized color semantics through the sequence return arrow configuration and SVG color writer, including no-paint, single-nibble gray and alpha; do not weaken comparison or reject these valid Java colors. Keep the command validation improvement bounded and retain this downstream dependency.

B9-LEGACY-LIFE: A self message permits a different participant's deactivate/activate pair and still owns the command stack entry. The new resolver preserves that correctly. Java LifeLine.finish counts raw accepted LARGER minus SMALLER variations, so an unmatched earlier close cancels the later open in its missing-close count; getSegment then ends the final unclosed opening at the last variation itself, yielding a zero-height Cedar segment. Rust's open-stack painter discards the unmatched close and unconditionally closes the remaining open at the diagram tail, emitting an extra Cedar activation bar. The Teoz counterpart passes because it uses the separate stairs model. Next repair: Model legacy finish/getSegment from the accepted ordered variation stream, including unmatched-close history; keep that paint history separate from the now-correct return owner stack.

B9-PARALLEL-CONTACT: Rust uses event_y_positions (message stroke/callback ordinate) as the common parallel contact for all message kinds. Java aligns component getYPoint, which for a self component is text height plus half of the 13-unit loop plus paddingX, whereas ordinary arrows use text height plus paddingY. These are separate from the self callback's activation-dependent p1/p2. The fresh chain and multiline controls leave ordinary messages and their activation starts 2.5 units too high while the self component matches. This is not a label-metric discrepancy. Next repair: Represent tile contact, drawing origin, callback ordinates and extent below contact separately, and compose their maxima exactly as TileParallel; do not add a case-specific 2.5 offset.

Parser serialization probe independently confirms both parallel fields preserve true and default absent old JSON fields to false. The color name/symbol set exactly equals157 Java registrations/symbols. Four fresh invalid controls reject correctly. Command stack ownership is distinct from paint acceptance, but the declared product mechanism still has live rendering dependencies; validation success alone is not acceptance.
